import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Restart server
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart areloria 2>&1")
print("Restart:", stdout.read().decode())
time.sleep(12)
# Check ports
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep -E '8080|3000'")
print("\nPorts:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check nginx serves static
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s https://arelorian.de/ | head -3")
print("\nSite:", stdout.read().decode()[:100])
client.close()
EOF
